vopros: Is there a service in the US that fixes wrong information about a business in AI answers?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Yes. **Some U.S. reputation-management and AI-search (GEO) agencies offer services to investigate and reduce inaccurate business information in AI answers.** For example, Reputation X advertises an AI-misinformation service, and Ignite Visibility offers AI SEO and monitoring that includes identifying and correcting inaccurate brand information. [Reputation X](https://www.reputationx.com/services/improve/ai-misinformation) · [Ignite Visibility](https://ignitevisibility.com/services/ai-seo/)

The important caveat: **they generally can’t directly edit ChatGPT, Gemini, or other AI answers, or guarantee a correction.** The work usually involves finding the websites or listings behind the error, correcting those sources where possible, strengthening accurate information elsewhere, and then monitoring whether answers change. AI providers also have feedback tools, but submitting a report doesn’t ensure a fix.

Before hiring, ask for a sample audit, what sources they’ll actually correct, how they’ll measure results, and what they explicitly *cannot* promise.

Large language models (LLMs) and AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity **don’t have an edit button** that lets you directly correct inaccurate business information in their responses.
Fixing outdated AI data requires **updating the sources the AI pulls from**, including your own website, Google Business Profile, local listings and other third-party directories.
**• Regularly Audit Your AI Presence** – Query major AI platforms using common user questions about your pricing, location, business hours and services to catch any inaccurate brand information.
**• Document Every Hallucination or Misinformation** – Take screenshots, timestamps and save the specific prompts used to create an evidence trail for tracking fixes over time.
**• Trace the Sources AI Is Citing** – Check real-time citations or run targeted search queries to pinpoint the specific sources causing the misinformation.
**• Correct the Outdated Information at the Source**– Update your website, clean up directory listings, align your Google and Bing business profiles and add schema markup to establish a unified source of truth.
...
There is **no direct fix for inaccurate business information in AI**.
Because LLMs dynamically generate answers by evaluating patterns across training data and live retrieval indexes, you cannot submit a ticket or request a manual update from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or Perplexity.
